plan.notes: Source: Otterbein University Department of Biology and Earth Science official 'Suggested Program of Study' for the Biology Major (BA). SUGGESTED SEQUENCE — explicitly a suggested program of study, not a required lockstep sequence. No explicit catalog year on the document; the PDF footer carries revision stamp 2/18/26, so catalog year is recorded as 2025-2026. Credit ranges resolved at minimums with disclosure: 'BIO Major Elective 3-4' slots transcribed at 3 credits; the 'BIO Major Elective or BIO 4950 Research (optional)' slots are single or-slots transcribed at 3. Term totals as transcribed (minimums): 15+14+16+15+12.5+12.5+15+15 = 115. The source prints junior-year term totals as 13-15/13-14 (row-by-row minimums sum to 12.5) and senior-year totals as ranges (15-16, 15-17); row-by-row minimums are shown here. The source requires 120 hours to graduate (footnote f); the gap is filled by student choice within the plan's ranges and electives. Ten upper-level hours (3000+) required including one writing-intensive upper-level course (footnote d). Courses marked '(skills)' satisfy the skill-development block. BIO 4998 Scientific Writing and BIO 4950 Research are marked optional in the source and shown where the source grids them. 'INST 2XXX' = any INST 2000-level course (may be taken in any order per the source). No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence left empty. BIO 3998 is taken in both semesters of junior year by program design (two semesters required per source footnote c); allow_repeated_courses is set.
